khmer_only.name: Khmer Conversational Greeting
khmer_only.text: សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំរីករាយណាស់ដែលបានជួបអ្នកនៅថ្ងៃនេះ។
khmer_only.phonetic_transcription: Suosdei! Khnhom rik-reay nas dael ban chuob anak now thngai nih.
khmer_only.english_meaning: Hello! I am very glad to meet you today.
khmer_only.linguistic_complexity: Basic conversational, high-frequency syllables, simple vowels.
khmer_only.expected_pronunciation_challenges: Tone/register separation between 'ស' (first register) and 'ញ' (second register in 'ខ្ញុំ').

khmer_only.name: Khmer Complex Orthography & Coeng Clusters
khmer_only.text: ប្រទេសកម្ពុជាសម្បូរទៅដោយសម្បត្តិវប្បធម៌ និងប្រាសាទបុរាណជាច្រើនដូចជាប្រាសាទអង្គរវត្ត។
khmer_only.phonetic_transcription: Prates Kampuchea sambor tow doy sambat vobbathoa ning prasat boran chea chraen dochchea prasat Angkor Wat.
khmer_only.english_meaning: Cambodia is rich in cultural heritage and ancient temples such as Angkor Wat temple.
khmer_only.linguistic_complexity: High. Subscript consonants (ជើងក, ជើងព, ជើងវ, ជើងត), Pali/Sanskrit loanwords, continuous script without inter-word spacing.
khmer_only.expected_pronunciation_challenges: Coeng consonant clusters (ម្ព, ម្ប, ប្ប) must not insert intrusive schwa vowels; word boundary segmentation.

khmer_only.name: Khmer Technical & AI Domain
khmer_only.text: បច្ចេកវិទ្យាបញ្ញាសិប្បនិម្មិត និងការបង្កើតសំឡេងដោយកុំព្យូទ័រកំពុងមានការរីកចម្រើនយ៉ាងឆាប់រហ័ស។
khmer_only.phonetic_transcription: Bachekvittyea banhha seppanimmot ning kar bangkeut samleng doy kompyuto kampoung mean kar rikchamroen yang chhab rohas.
khmer_only.english_meaning: Artificial intelligence technology and computer speech synthesis are progressing very rapidly.
khmer_only.linguistic_complexity: Medium-High. Modern technical neologisms and loanwords.
khmer_only.expected_pronunciation_challenges: Pronunciation of loanword 'កុំព្យូទ័រ' (computer) and composite neologism 'បញ្ញាសិប្បនិម្មិត' (AI).

english_only.name: English Conversational Greeting
english_only.text: Hello and welcome to VoiceStudio AI, running entirely on your local Windows computer.
english_only.linguistic_complexity: Low. Standard conversational syntax and phonemes.

english_only.name: English Phonetically Balanced Benchmark
english_only.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the vibrant, sparkling riverbank.
english_only.linguistic_complexity: Medium. Covers all English alphabetic phonemes, plosives, fricatives, and nasals.
english_only.expected_pronunciation_challenges: Clarity of fricatives (/f/, /v/, /z/, /th/) and consonant clusters (/br/, /sp/, /nk/).

english_only.name: English Technical AI Narrative
english_only.text: VoxCPM2 is a tokenizer-free diffusion autoregressive foundation model supporting forty-eight kilohertz studio-grade speech output.
english_only.linguistic_complexity: High. Technical terminology, multi-syllabic compound nouns.
english_only.expected_pronunciation_challenges: Stress placement on 'autoregressive' and numerical phonemes.

khmer_english_mixed.name: Khmer-English Code-Switching (Technical)
khmer_english_mixed.text: សូមស្វាគមន៍មកកាន់ VoiceStudio AI ដែលដំណើរការលើ Local Computer របស់អ្នក។
khmer_english_mixed.english_meaning: Welcome to VoiceStudio AI running on your Local Computer.
khmer_english_mixed.expected_pronunciation_challenges: Smooth transition between Khmer phonological system and English phonemes without pitch drop or stuttering.

khmer_english_mixed.name: Khmer-English Code-Switching (Development Stack)
khmer_english_mixed.text: កម្មវិធីនេះបង្កើតឡើងដោយ Python និង Gradio សម្រាប់គ្រប់គ្រង Voice Profile ក្នុង SQLite Database។
khmer_english_mixed.english_meaning: This application is built with Python and Gradio to manage Voice Profiles in a SQLite Database.
khmer_english_mixed.expected_pronunciation_challenges: Acronyms ('SQLite') and framework names ('Gradio', 'Python') inside Khmer sentence grammar.
